verdict.rationale: Missive's MCP integration page says you can connect any MCP-compatible server to its AI Copilot. Setup is documented: add "Custom MCP", enter a name and server URL, and choose an authentication method. It also ships ready-made MCP integrations for Notion, Linear, Attio and Lindy.ai, and the assistant runs on your own Anthropic, OpenAI or Gemini key. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that custom MCP connections work, and detail on supported transports (only remote server URLs are evidenced, not local stdio servers) and tool-permission controls.
